$comment: A case study's stored fields, by the founder's rulings of 18/11/2026 on the ID-3944 field names. A case study is fixed fields: it has no page body. The address (slug) and the editor's order are each platform's own (SC-003). The view's document (fixtures/case-study) is these fields as the case-study view receives them, with services resolved to cards for display.
label: Case study

nextjs.owes: a count as the editor types that notes a title past about 60 characters and notes more strongly one past 120, never refused

wordpress.owes: a count as the editor types that notes a title past about 60 characters and notes more strongly one past 120, never refused
the taxonomy box labelled Topics, with no parent control

fields.name: client
fields.label: Client
fields.description: Optional. The client's name as free text, shown on the card and beneath the title. With clients enabled it is the fallback when no client record is chosen or the chosen one no longer resolves.

fields.name: clientRecord
fields.label: Client record
fields.description: Optional. One client from the clients collection, offered only when the site enables clients. Its name replaces the free-text client wherever the client is drawn; with none chosen, or one that no longer resolves, the free text is drawn.

nextjs.owes: the field, kept with its stored ID when clients is switched off (SC-035)

wordpress.owes: the field, an ACF post object returning an ID, kept with its stored ID when clients is switched off (SC-035)

fields.name: sector
fields.label: Sector
fields.description: Optional. The sector's name as free text. Stored and offered to editors; no public slot draws it until its presentation is ruled.

fields.name: sectorRecord
fields.label: Sector record
fields.description: Optional. One sector from the sectors collection, offered only when the site enables sectors. No public slot draws it until its presentation is ruled.

nextjs.owes: the field, kept with its stored ID when sectors is switched off (SC-035)

wordpress.owes: the field, an ACF post object returning an ID, kept with its stored ID when sectors is switched off (SC-035)

fields.name: summary
fields.label: Summary
fields.description: One or two sentences, shown on cards wherever the item is listed.

nextjs.owes: a target of 300 characters, shown with a count and never refused

wordpress.formerly: summary (an ACF textarea with no limit)
wordpress.owes: the summary stored in the excerpt, with a target of 300 characters, shown with a count and never refused

fields.name: gallery
fields.label: Gallery
fields.description: Optional. When given, at least one image; aim for no more than 24.

nextjs.owes: the minimum of one, and a target of 24 images, shown with a count and never refused

wordpress.owes: the minimum of one, and a target of 24 images, shown with a count and never refused
the restricted list: paragraphs, bold, italic, links, lists, and headings 3 and 4

fields.name: caseStudyImage
fields.label: Case study image
fields.description: Optional. One image, drawn between the challenge and what we did; its alt text is the image's own. Not drawn when it is the featured image.

wordpress.owes: the restricted list: paragraphs, bold, italic, links, lists, and headings 3 and 4

fields.name: results
fields.label: Results
fields.description: Optional. When given, at least one, each a figure and what it measures; aim for no more than six.

nextjs.owes: the minimum of one, and a target of six, shown with a count and never refused

wordpress.owes: the minimum of one, and a target of six, shown with a count and never refused

fields.name: details
fields.label: Project details
fields.description: Optional. Such as Location: Cumbria; aim for no more than 12.

nextjs.owes: a target of 12, shown with a count and never refused

wordpress.owes: the field, with a target of 12, shown with a count and never refused

fields.name: externalUrl
fields.label: Live site
fields.description: Optional. The address of the finished site, opened in a new tab.

nextjs.owes: the url format's check on publish, a draft still saving

wordpress.owes: a text field with the url format, named externalUrl

dropped.note: No view reads it: a case study is fixed fields. Any content migrates into solution; the summary in the excerpt keeps site search reading more than the title.
Unread, and a collection has one list of topics.

display.$comment: Derived from Salt for Next.js's READ_CARD and Salt for WordPress's inc/sections/work.php, with the rc.7 names. A featured showcase's lead card also draws the case study's results (view-props/collection-showcase.json results), from results.

href.note: The case study's own page. Routing is each platform's own.

meta.note: The client's name: the chosen client record's title when the site enables clients and the record resolves, otherwise the free-text client; drawn only when non-empty (SC-035). A record is never a link.

tags.note: When the section shows tags. Each topic's title.
